candidates.mechanism: Long-or-flat SMA75 trend filter on inflation/growth assets: if yesterday's close < SMA75 (shift 1), weight -> 0 and park in short credit; else hold the risk-parity weight. Applied to non-ferrous metals, gold, S&P 500 and WTI (75d) and CSI300 (30d).
candidates.title: XCUUSD multi_speed_trend (B-AWP-01)
candidates.falsifier: Filtered sleeve log-growth <= always-long, or the gain disappears at SMA50/SMA100 (fragility).
